newsitem.title: USA: Westcoast has partial outage at gas plant.
newsitem.headline: Westcoast has partial outage at gas plant.

text.p: Westocast Energy Inc's McMahon gas processing plant in British Columbia, partially shut down late Wednesday, is expected to return to full power by Saturday, the company said Thursday.
"It's on its way back to 50 percent (power) today," said company spokesman Pat Bowles, noting capacity at the plant is 650 million cubic feet per day (mmcfd).
The plant will likely remain at 50 percent power Friday but then return to full service on Saturday morning, she said.

As a result of the partial outage, prices at Sumas, Wash., the Canada-U.S. export point, surged into the $5.00-10.00 per million British thermal units range, compared with around $4.00 on Wednesday, traders said.
The company blamed the outage on faulty valves on the raw gas liquid receiving system.
